title: POV: Same Paycheck as Your Coworkers, But You Save $800

lines: You and your coworkers just got paid the exact same four thousand dollars.
scenes.img: {HERO} in an office smiling at his phone showing a deposit, coworkers around him also looking at phones, vertical composition

lines: Jake just financed a truck. Eight hundred ninety a month.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt proudly leaning on a huge shiny new pickup truck in a parking lot, vertical composition

lines: Mia is booking a trip on a credit card with over twenty percent interest.
scenes.img: a woman with a ponytail booking a vacation on her phone with a credit card in hand, excited, vertical composition

lines: You? Eight hundred dollars left your account the second you got paid. Automatically.
scenes.img: {HERO} on his couch looking at a phone with a green check mark savings transfer, relaxed, vertical composition

lines: Fifty percent needs. Thirty percent wants. Twenty percent future. Decided once.
scenes.img: a big pie chart in blue orange and green drawn on a whiteboard, {HERO} pointing at the green slice, vertical composition

lines: One year later, layoff rumors hit the office. Jake can't sleep.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt lying awake in bed at night with his phone glowing, worried, vertical composition

lines: You have almost ten thousand dollars saved. You're calm.
scenes.img: {HERO} calmly drinking coffee by a window at sunrise, peaceful smile, vertical composition

lines: Same paycheck. Different plan. The full story is on my channel.
scenes.img: {HERO} walking out of an office building at sunset, confident, coworkers stressed in the background, vertical composition
